request.style: English, male baritone voice, warm and gentle, solo with soft backing choir, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, light percussion, contemplative and serene, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
You heard the old command given
Love your neighbor, hate the foe
But I tell you something new now
Love your enemies, go and show
Pray for those who persecute
Seek the peace that they refuse

[Chorus]
So that you may be sons of the Father
In the heaven above
He makes his sun rise on the evil
And the good alike
He sends rain on the righteous
And the unrighteous too

[Verse]
What reward do you have then
Loving those who love you back
Even tax collectors do the same
So your love is not unique
If you greet only your brothers
What more are you doing now
Even the Gentiles do the same
So stand apart in how

[Chorus]
So that you may be sons of the Father
In the heaven above
He makes his sun rise on the evil
And the good alike
He sends rain on the righteous
And the unrighteous too

[Bridge]
You therefore are to be perfect
As your heavenly Father is
Not in sinless flawlessness
But in overflowing bliss
Love that reaches out beyond
Where the heart is bound

[Outro]
Rain on the unrighteous
Sun on the evil
Perfect in this love
